title: Bias Robustness of Genetic Multi-Criteria Sorting versus Learned Rankers under Proxy Skew and Label Contamination
abstract: arXiv:2610.14015v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning-to-rank (LTR) models can align rankings with undesignated signals when those signals appear as features or leak into training labels. We compare label-free genetic multi-criteria sorting (open Pikaia strategy variants), which reranks fixed candidate pools using an explicit criteria vector C, to label-trained LTR (LightGBM, XGBoost, RankSVM) under two controlled protocols on MSLR-WEB10K, Baidu-ULTR, WANDS, and Expedia. In the main proxy-skew study, labels remain clean while a calibrated proxy P is available as a feature: Genetic AI rankings show lower Spearman rank-proxy correlation than the LTR peers (e.g. about 0.15-0.16 vs. 0.59-0.87 on WANDS), with both families evaluated jointly on clean nDCG@10 on a bias-utility frontier. In a supporting label-contamination study, training labels are mixed with contaminant B: because Genetic AI methods do not use labels, their bias and utility curves stay flat, whereas LightGBM and XGBoos

translated_title: 代理偏差与标签污染下遗传多准则排序相较于学习型排序器的偏差鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 当未指定的信号以特征形式出现或泄漏到训练标签中时，学习排序模型可能会使排序结果与这些信号保持一致。我们在MSLR-WEB10K、Baidu-ULTR、WANDS和Expedia数据集上，通过两种受控协议，将无标签的遗传多准则排序方法（开放的Pikaia策略变体，使用显式准则向量C对固定候选池进行重排）与基于标签训练的LTR方法（LightGBM、XGBoost、RankSVM）进行对比。在主要的代理偏差研究中，标签保持干净，同时一个校准过的代理P作为特征可用：遗传AI排序显示出的Spearman秩-代理相关性低于LTR同行（例如在WANDS上约为0.15-0.16，而LTR为0.59-0.87），两类方法在偏差-效用边界上基于干净nDCG@10进行联合评估。在一项辅助性的标签污染研究中，训练标签与污染物B混合：由于遗传AI方法不使用标签，其偏差和效用曲线保持平稳，而LightGBM和XGBoost……
tldr: 本文通过受控实验证明，无标签的遗传多准则排序方法对代理偏差和标签污染具有天然鲁棒性——其排序与偏差信号相关性显著更低且性能不受标签污染影响，而传统学习排序模型则容易与偏差信号对齐。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates through controlled experiments that label-free genetic multi-criteria sorting is inherently robust to proxy skew and label contamination—exhibiting much lower correlation with biased proxy signals and stable performance under contamination—whereas learned rankers tend to align with biased signals.
